title: Terms of Sale
intro: These terms govern purchases from {companyName}. VAT {vat}. Contact: {email}. Address: {address}. Phone: {phone}.
section1Body: {companyName} sells the products shown in this shop. Legal identity: VAT {vat}, {address}.
section2Body: An order is an offer to buy. We accept it when payment is confirmed or when we confirm a cash-on-delivery or bank-transfer order. Prices are shown in the shop currency.
section3Body: Physical goods ship to the address you provide at checkout. Digital products are delivered to your account. Delivery times are estimates.
section4Body: Return requests are handled by shop staff. Contact {email} with your order number if you need to return an item.
